The name is a trap: "Ripple USD" and "RLUSD" borrow the identity of a real stablecoin and project. Treat that as a red flag, not a brand.

The 30-minute return of +2.1% and drawdown of 0.03% show a flat, supply-controlled tape, not demand that will persist.
